method: Hand review of design/parity/evidence/<row>/comparison.png (reference, built, pixelmatch diff) against Material Design 3 component anatomy and the checked-in reference.

primitives.finding: Cards carry the 24 px version, a mono date chip, the LATEST / THIS BUILD pill and category chips (ADDED green, FIXED secondary, CHANGED amber, SECURITY error) with wrapping change text and hairline separators (repaired 2026-09-01). Code names are absent: the bundled CHANGELOG.md does not record them; they live in the GitHub release notes.

All time / Last 90 days / Last year / Last 2 years filter chips on their own row above the two date pickers (repaired 2026-09-01). The from/to fields are Material date fields with the anchored calendar picker (repaired 2026-09-02).
Export Markdown and copy actions present.
Built states 'Completion commit unavailable' for the pending release honestly.
